---
title: "Dr. Ousmane Diao"
---

**Senior Research Scientist, MAP Dar es Salaam Node, Ifakara Health Institute**

Dr. Diao's expertise spans mathematical engineering, geospatial
modelling, and malaria epidemiology. He develops and implements
spatiotemporal models to estimate malaria, assess transmission profiles,
and evaluate intervention strategies. He has contributed to capacity
strengthening through teaching and training in geospatial modelling
across Africa, including the Malaria Modelling training school (MaMOD)
and MAP ECR training programmes.

He holds a PhD in Mathematical Engineering from UCLouvain, Belgium, and
an MSc in Bioinformatics/Biomathematics from UCAD, Senegal, and has
published widely on malaria and infectious disease modelling.
